calibration.reason: The chosen constant bars are disclosed and given substantive interpretations: annual asset growth above 10%, mean cash coverage above 2, narrative ending-fixed-asset turnover above 3 with a separately reported strict bar above 4, and mean operating-cash-flow conversion above 1. The source-derived sequential checks show 27/48, 17/27, 12/17, and 6/12 admissions, so no gate deliberately admits everything or eliminates nearly all entrants. The disclosed plus-or-minus 10% sensitivity results remain nonempty, do not admit most of the pool, and appropriately identify narrative efficiency as the most locally sensitive bar without claiming certainty or changing bars by company.

core_method.reason: The declared primary narrative method fixes consolidated monetary funds, total operating income, consolidated net profit, ending fixed assets, a component-complete interest-bearing-debt definition with leases explicitly excluded, the annual 2019-2021 window with 2018 as the first growth base, and strict greater-than comparisons uniformly across companies. It preserves signed profit ratios in the narrative reading while disclosing the strict non-positive-profit treatment, treats unavailable binding inputs as REVIEW, limits borrowing evidence to co-movement, and states that no discount-rate input is used. The same-statement TOTAL_LIAB_EQUITY fallback is source-recorded and is the accounting-identity equivalent of the null TOTAL_ASSETS value, not an invented or interpolated fact.
